meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 多出两个工具:列出 Atomic Chat 本地模型,以及把提示词发给指定模型并拿回回复。需要先注册 MCP server 并重建容器才生效。
howto.when: 当你提到 atomic chat,或要求用本地模型生成回答、列出可用本地模型时触发。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
say.note: 会先列出模型,再生成回答

say.text: 列出 atomic chat 里现在有哪些模型

howto.what_en: Claude gains two tools: atomic_chat_list_models lists models available in the Atomic Chat app, atomic_chat_generate sends a prompt to a chosen model and returns its reply. The MCP server must be registered and the container rebuilt.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention atomic chat or local models, ask Claude to list available local models, or request a reply from an Atomic Chat model.

say_en.text: use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: It lists models first, then generates the answer.

say_en.text: list the models currently available in atomic chat
use atomic_chat_generate with llama3.2-3b-instruct to answer: 1+1
say_en.note: Model ID must match the listed ones.
